verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents native BM25 full-text search over string and []string attributes inside the database (docs-15), plus trigram-indexed regex search (docs-2) and server-side RRF fusion with vector results (docs-16). Its own positioning as a 'vector and full-text search engine' (docs-38, probe-1) confirms no separate search engine is needed. missing for 10: evidence of FTS depth (tokenizers/language analyzers, phrase or fuzzy matching), independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality.
